about.data: Amazon Reviews 2023 (McAuley Lab), Video Games category, used for research and coursework
about.split: all 8,000 decisions of 3,615 people; the temperature is fitted on one half of the people and applied to the other
about.model: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, fine-tuned on earlier purchases, then preference-trained, with one confidence temperature
about.ask_rule: asks the one yes/no question about brand or category with the most information, when the expected gain from asking is high
limitations: Tested on past Amazon purchases in one category, video games.
It sees product names, brands and categories, not prices or reviews.
It needs a purchase history. People with no history are always asked.
